top_signals.title: B&Q sales slip but owner Kingfisher lifts profit target
top_signals.summary: Home improvement group Kingfisher has lifted its profit target despite seeing summer heatwaves push down sales at B&Q.  The FTSE 100 retailer, which also owns Screwfix, said it now expects to make a pre-tax profit of between £595m and £635m, having previously guided between £565m and £625m. Last year, the group posted a £560m profit.  [...]
